name: Corrected Calcium
template:
Corrected Calcium

Adjusts calcium for albumin level

Normal: 2.20-2.60 mmol/L
Normal: 35-50 g/L
Formula:
Corrected Ca²⁺ = Measured Ca²⁺ + 0.02 × (40 - Albumin)

Interpretation:
• Normal: 2.20-2.60 mmol/L
• <2.20: Hypocalcemia
• >2.60: Hypercalcemia
• >3.00: Severe hypercalcemia (requires urgent treatment)
